s: The SAM platform has the capacity to bring on several thousand new clients while adding new functionality such as Rich Communication Services (RCS) and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
We will be introducing RCS to SAM in April 2019 and the AI functionality in the second half of 2019.
By adding RCS and AI, we can add customer value and higher priced solutions to any vertical we are pursuing.
We are pursuing AI assets to add to SAM which will establish us as a pure technology company with an advanced communication platform.
We feel the transformation into a technology company with AI will open new revenue streams and add value to our technology assets.
